frame: Rater frame: precision first. Omit a guarantee unless the packet names a deployed artifact and a locator. Score the protocol as an element of the agentic commerce stack, not as a standalone product. Kleros is scored as a candidate L8 for agent-speed commerce, not as a general-purpose court.

C.promise: Scoped authority via signed Intent/Cart Mandates as W3C VCs; human-present and human-absent flows.
C.evidence: Google blog + UCP binding describe tamper-proof VCs and chain of evidence; repo has samples.
C.failure: Revocation not consistently propagated into settlement; signature ≠ faithful execution (Ledger L4).

I.promise: Payment-agnostic (cards, stablecoins, RT bank); A2A/x402 extension; UCP binds AP2 mandates.
I.evidence: Blog lists rails and collaborators; UCP spec references AP2 VCs.
I.failure: Bindings are suggested/one-ecosystem; no auditable cross-rail verification spec.
I.metric: Number of independently verified cross-rail implementations.

A.promise: Auth safety via signed mandates; auditability via intent→cart→payment chain; partial exec/price.
A.evidence: Blog: non-repudiable audit trail; VCs for consent. No finality, compliance, or recovery artifacts.
A.failure: No economic finality guarantee; no KYC/AML attribution; no refund/rollback/arbitration.
A.metric: Count of seven properties with deployed artifacts (4).

EM.promise: Payment-agnostic rails (incl. stablecoins, RT bank) reduce card/bank dependence.
EM.evidence: Blog lists multiple rails; no deployed EM-specific artifact or loss-bearer inspection tool.
EM.failure: Still needs platform trust and legal enforcement; no fallback for weak institutions.
EM.metric: Usability without cards/courts with inspectable artifact.

S.promise: Public GitHub spec, reference implementations, 60+ collaborators; positions as A2A/MCP extension.
S.evidence: spec-ap2 repo; blog announcement; UCP binding.
S.failure: No named governance body or standards process; limited independent implementers beyond collaborators.
S.metric: Versioned spec + named governance + multiple independent implementations.

C.promise: HTTP 402 binds cryptographic payment proof to request; facilitator verifies and settles on-chain.
C.evidence: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; schemes exact/upto/batch; mainnet facilitators (Coinbase CDP, PayAI).
C.failure: Payment finality does not bind to service delivery; subjective-quality forum absent (L5 T3).
C.metric: Settlement tx hash vs. 200 OK; no atomic delivery predicate.

I.promise: Blockchain-agnostic via CAIP-2; optional Signed Offers/Receipts; IETF drafts for evidence frame.
I.evidence: EVM/Solana/Algorand SDKs; AP2 A2A extension; ERC-8004 proofOfPayment hook.
I.failure: Bindings are optional or draft; no auditable cross-layer seam for delivery or compliance.
I.metric: CAIP-2 network ID present; receipt signature optional.

A.promise: Auth via signed mandate; execution preserved by facilitator; audit via receipts; pricing via signed offer.
A.evidence: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; exact/upto schemes; optional Signed Offers & Receipts on 402/200.
A.failure: Receipts optional; compliance and refund still IETF drafts; no native rollback or forum.
A.metric: Count of yes+partial properties: auth_safety, exec_correct, econ_finality, price_correct, auditability = 4.

EM.promise: No KYC or bank account required; stablecoin settlement; works without cards or platform trust.
EM.evidence: Zero-friction base flow; multi-chain SDKs; facilitator settles to recipient address.
EM.failure: Depends on facilitator trust and on-chain gas; no legal enforcement or fiat off-ramp guarantee.
EM.metric: Recipient can inspect settlement tx; no court or refund artifact.

S.promise: Public spec, Linux Foundation x402 Foundation, multiple SDKs, IETF drafts, major cloud members.
S.evidence: TS/Go/Python SDKs; Express/Next/Hono/FastAPI middleware; Stripe, Cloudflare, AWS members.
S.failure: Core spec not a formal standards-body track; key assurance extensions remain drafts.
S.metric: Independent implementers ≥3; IETF drafts not yet RFC.

C.evidence: Order object with fulfillment events and refund adjustments; webhooks.
C.failure: Post-purchase state and refund portability remain merchant-specific (T4).

I.promise: Bindings to AP2 (L4), A2A/MCP (L2/L3), OAuth identity (L1).
I.failure: Economic finality delegated to PSP/card rails; no cross-layer settlement guarantee.
I.metric: Verifiable binding to AP2 mandate + PSP finality.

A.promise: Auth via AP2 mandates; execution via order object; audit via webhooks.
A.evidence: AP2 payment via mandates/VCs; fulfillment events; refund adjustments.
A.failure: No economic finality, compliance continuity, or native recoverability.

EM.evidence: No dependency on cards/KYC bureau explicitly stated; PSP fallback required.
EM.failure: Still requires PSP/bank for finality; no offline or low-trust artifact.

S.promise: Versioned spec; multi-vendor endorsement (Google, Shopify, Stripe, Visa).
S.evidence: Public spec at ucp.dev; GitHub repo; named capabilities.
S.failure: Lodging/food verticals 'coming soon'; no independent production count.

C.promise: Portable identity + behavioral trust registry for L1 adverse selection.
C.evidence: Three registries (identity, reputation, validation) with on-chain feedback and optional zkML/TEE hooks.
C.failure: Identity ≠ capability; Sybil inflation; capability claims not cryptographically guaranteed.
C.metric: getSummary with clientAddresses filter; validation response 0–100.

I.promise: Cross-layer discovery via A2A/MCP/ENS/DID endpoints and optional x402Support flag.
I.evidence: Registration file includes endpoints for L2/L3 protocols; feedback MAY include proofOfPayment tx hash.
I.failure: Reputation per-registry; no binding of feedback to AP2 mandates or x402 settlement; cross-chain metric absent.
I.metric: Optional x402Support field; proofOfPayment hash in feedback.

A.promise: On-chain audit trail of identity, feedback, and validation responses.
A.evidence: giveFeedback/revoke/appendResponse recorded on-chain; optional IPFS file; validation hooks for stakers/TEE.
A.failure: No authorization scope, execution correctness, pricing, compliance, or economic finality guarantees.
A.metric: On-chain event logs for feedback and validation; IPFS CID for extended proof.

EM.promise: Permissionless registry usable without banks, courts, or platform trust.
EM.evidence: Deployable as per-chain singleton on L2 or mainnet; no KYC or card dependency in spec.
EM.failure: Still requires chain access and gas; no legal enforcement or currency stability mechanism.
EM.metric: Registry deployable on any EVM chain; no institutional prerequisites beyond wallet.

S.promise: Draft EIP with multi-stakeholder authorship (MetaMask, EF, Google, Coinbase).
S.evidence: Public EIP-8004 draft and Magicians thread; no final status or multiple independent implementations cited.
S.failure: Draft status; no versioned governance or ratified implementations confirmed.
S.metric: EIP draft stage; Magicians discussion thread active.

C.promise: Machine-readable tool/resource discovery for L2/L3 agent-to-tool interop.
C.evidence: Capability discovery (prompts, resources, tools) in versioned docs 2026-07-28.
C.failure: Advertised capability not bound to demonstrated competence (Ledger L2).
C.metric: Discovery completeness vs. demonstrated execution fidelity.

I.promise: Connects AI apps to tools/data across clients (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor).
I.evidence: Broad independent client implementations; UCP lists MCP as first-class transport.
I.failure: No specified binding to payment, mandate, or dispute layers; Web2–Web3 propagation absent.

A.evidence: Trust model mentions user-mediated delegation; L3 notes tool-call logs exist.
A.failure: No payment, settlement, compliance, or recovery artifacts; execution fidelity to principal intent unclosed.
A.metric: Count of seven assurance properties with observable artifact.

EM.promise: Web2 tool connectivity usable without cards or banks for discovery.
EM.evidence: Open standard with broad client support; no dependency on payment rails for tool calls.
EM.failure: No fallback for enforcement, identity, or currency stability; depends on platform trust for clients.
EM.metric: Institutional dependency count (banking, legal, ID, platform, currency).

S.promise: Versioned open standard with multiple independent implementations.
S.evidence: Docs dated 2026-07-28; clients include Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor; cited in surveys.
S.failure: No named governance body or formal standards process stated in packet.
S.metric: Independent implementer count; versioned spec presence.

C.promise: Machine-readable agent discovery and task routing across L2/L3.
C.evidence: Agent Card JSON schema; Task lifecycle; SDKs in 6 languages.
C.failure: Capability claims unbound to demonstrated performance; adverse selection open.
C.metric: Task completion rate vs advertised skill match.

I.promise: HTTP/JSON interop with auth in headers; complementary to MCP and AP2.
I.evidence: Agent Card URL used by UCP transport; AP2 described as A2A payment extension.
I.failure: No auditable cross-layer binding; no Web3 settlement rail native to A2A.
I.metric: Count of independent L4/L5 integrations verifying A2A task IDs.

A.promise: Task traces for message auditability; auth declared on Agent Card.
A.evidence: Task ID + Message/Part/Artifact records; HTTP header auth; no payment/finality.
A.failure: No execution correctness, economic finality, pricing, compliance, or recoverability.
A.metric: Reconstructable task trace from logs; auth scope check.

EM.evidence: Open spec, multi-vendor TSC; no banking/ID/court dependency stated.
EM.failure: Still requires stable HTTP infra, auth provider, and L5 rail for value transfer.
EM.metric: Deployments in jurisdictions without card/KYC/court fallback.

S.promise: Versioned public spec under Linux Foundation with named TSC governance.
S.evidence: TSC: AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow; 6 SDKs.
S.failure: No corpus-tagged official spec record; live spec only; limited independent audits.
S.metric: Number of independent implementations beyond TSC members.

C.promise: Stream agent state, UI intents, and user interactions (L7 information revelation).
C.evidence: Event-based protocol with streaming chat, generative UI, shared state, interrupts, and custom events.
C.failure: Interface success can hide weaker seams (T5); no enforceable remedy or settlement binding.
C.metric: Event types and SDK coverage across frameworks; no checkable metric for revelation fidelity.

I.promise: Interoperate with MCP (tools) and A2A (agents) as adjacent layers; multi-framework SDKs.
I.evidence: Integration table lists LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, Mastra, Pydantic AI; SDKs in Kotlin/Go/Dart/Java/Rust.
I.failure: No specified binding to L4/L5/L8 rails; no auditable cross-layer propagation of guarantees.
I.metric: Count of named integrations; no verifiable cross-layer audit trail.

A.promise: Observability via streaming events and HITL interrupts.
A.evidence: Docs describe thinking-step visualization, interrupts (pause/approve/edit/retry), and custom events.
A.failure: No mandate, settlement, pricing, compliance, or recovery objects; docs warn agents are nondeterministic.
A.metric: Zero of seven properties addressed with an observable artifact.

EM.evidence: No artifacts for banking access, legal enforcement, formal ID, platform trust, or currency stability.
EM.failure: Depends on platform trust and formal infrastructure; no fallback for weak institutions.
EM.metric: No EM-relevant artifact or metric in docs.

S.promise: Open protocol with versioned docs and multi-language SDKs.
S.evidence: Public docs, GitHub repo, SDKs in 5+ languages, integrations with major agent frameworks.
S.failure: Originated from single vendor (CopilotKit); no named governance body or standards process.
S.metric: SDK count and integration breadth; no independent governance record.

C.promise: L8 contract enforcement: forum, rule, consequence for disputes.
C.evidence: Crowdsourced jurors stake PNK, vote via Schelling-point; ERC-792/ERC-1497 standards; Court, Escrow products live since 2019.
C.failure: Resolution latency is days, not agent-speed; not wired as default L8 for AP2/x402/UCP.
C.metric: Mean resolution time (days); not measured in packet.

I.promise: Arbitrable interface (ERC-792) allows any contract to call Kleros as arbitrator.
I.evidence: ERC-792 Arbitration + ERC-1497 Evidence standards; Escrow product integrates dispute resolution.
I.failure: No specified binding to AP2/x402/UCP; integration is optional, not a default seam.
I.metric: Count of L4–L7 protocols with native Kleros binding (zero in packet).

A.promise: Auditability of dispute flow; recoverability via arbitration ruling.
A.evidence: On-chain evidence submission (ERC-1497); appeal hierarchy; ruling emitted on-chain.
A.failure: Auth safety, execution correctness, economic finality, pricing, compliance not addressed by Kleros itself.
A.metric: 3 of 7 properties addressed (auditability yes; recoverability partial; rest no).

EM.promise: Dispute resolution without reliance on traditional courts or banks.
EM.evidence: On-chain arbitration with global juror pool; Escrow product usable without card rails.
EM.failure: Still requires internet, crypto on-ramp, and PNK stake; legal enforcement of rulings is jurisdiction-dependent.
EM.metric: Usable without local court (yes); without banking (partial); without formal ID (partial).

S.promise: Versioned ERC standards (792, 1497); cooperative governance; live since 2019.
S.evidence: Multiple products (Court, Curate, Escrow, Scout); Snapshot governance; Stanford JBLP article.
S.failure: No agent-speed standard; not adopted as default L8 in agentic commerce stack.
S.metric: 2 ERCs published; 3+ products live; 0 default L8 integrations in packet.
